_comment: Hand-maintained VFW Post 7294 specials + events. Maintained weekly via Claude Cowork — check https://www.vfwpost7294.org/ for new posts (typically published weekly by McKayla Herman) and transcribe specials/events here.
_format: weeklySpecials: { dateRange (human-readable), validThrough (ISO date — last day specials are valid, exclusive), items (array of strings, optional ' (Fri only)' or ' (Friday only)' suffix). events: array of { title, date (ISO with TZ), endTime (optional ISO with TZ), description (optional), price (optional) }. Date/time uses America/New_York offset.

events.title: Memorial Day Ceremony and Brunch
events.description: Annual Memorial Day ceremony and brunch at VFW Post 7294. All are welcome.

events.title: Trivia Night
events.description: Wednesday Night Trivia at the Post. Rack your brain and have some fun — win some great prizes!
